title: QPB harness job manifest
description: Per-job manifest. Lives in queue/, then claimed/, then results/. Mirrored across the three states via atomic rename (Council A-5 two-phase commit).

task_id.description: UUID for this job. Threaded into worker prompt header (TASK_ID=<uuid>) and emitted in every heartbeat line.

repo.description: Absolute path or URL of the target repo.

state.description: State-machine position. Transitions enumerated in references/STATE_MACHINE.md.

cli_command.description: Required when dispatch_mode=cross_cli. Verbatim shell command (sans worker prompt).

dispatched_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the harness moved this manifest queue/->claimed/. Absent for state=queued.

last_heartbeat_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp of the most recent heartbeat read in the last tick. Used for stall detection.

result_file.description: Path (relative to run-dir) of the terminal result file. Populated by the tick that moves manifest claimed/->results/.

failure_subtype.description: Present when state=failed. Distinguishes 'never started' from 'started then stalled' from 'started then explicitly failed'.
